name: Rentenier (Retiree/Pensioner) Residence Permit

requirements.blocker_text: Applicant must intend to live in Curacao on retirement/pension income and submit a request for a residence permit as a Rentenier.

outcome.duration_length: not specified in the source reviewed

sources.title: Immigratiedienst Curacao -- Rentenier (Retiree/Pensioner) residence permit landing page

notes: NEW ROUTE, part of Curacao's initial build. This is a genuinely thin source: no minimum pension/passive-income figure, permit duration, or work-rights statement was found on the official landing page, only that the category exists and requires a form and payment order. The hard requirement here is deliberately qualitative (that sufficient retirement income must be shown) rather than a fabricated number -- flagged as an open gap for a future pass with access to the underlying application/requirement checklist (downloadable on the source page but not independently retrieved here). work_rights is conservatively 'none' since a retirement-income-based status would not typically confer local labour-market access and nothing in the source suggests otherwise. switchable_to points to cw_permanent_residence.json on the same reasoning as cw_work_permit.json and cw_investors_permit.json: lawful residence here plausibly counts toward the 10-year clock, though not explicitly confirmed.
